throat.interpretation_guardrail: The sonic transition is detected from area-averaged CFD cut planes. The interpolated sonic state is an estimate between sampled stations and must not be represented as an exact CFD root solve.

coverage.note: Global pressure, temperature, and density extrema are checked. When a geometry manifest is provided, throat entry, center, exit, sonic transition, and recent throat-center history are also extracted.

visual_observation.pressure_observation: Pressure exhibits a smooth decrease along the converging section, reaching a local minimum or expansion feature near the throat, followed by a slight recovery or lower pressure region in the diverging/straight section.
visual_observation.mach_observation: Mach number increases progressively from the inlet through the converging section and reaches supersonic values downstream of the throat, showing localized gradient features near the throat region.
visual_observation.velocity_observation: Velocity magnitude mirrors the Mach number distribution, showing low values at the inlet and accelerating significantly through the converging-diverging transition to reach high speeds downstream.
visual_observation.mesh_observation: The mesh is unstructured with local refinement clustered densely around the throat region where flow gradients are highest, while being coarser in the upstream and downstream sections.
qualitative_anomalies: slight asymmetry in the oblique shock-like pattern originating from the throat

evidence_used: Solver completed normally without NaN or Inf.

Stationarity tests indicate the solution has not yet reached required stationarity criteria (passes_stationarity is false).
Mass imbalance percentage is around 1.06%, which is still evolving.

evidence_for: Solver is numerically healthy and stable.
Stationarity criteria are not yet met but the solution is actively evolving.
No mesh or boundary failure flags are raised.
evidence_against: Mass imbalance persists around one percent.

evidence_for: Strong gradients and sonic transition are located at the throat.
evidence_against: checkMesh passed and no quantitative resolution deficiency or quality error has been demonstrated.

decision.reasoning_summary: The simulation is numerically stable, physically admissible, and completed normally, but it has not satisfied the stationarity criteria yet. Since the run is still evolving and health metrics are good, continuing the run is the correct path.

reasons: CONTINUE_RUN is permitted for a healthy evolving solution.
